title: Agentic Passport
tagline: Agentic Passport helps you verify if your agent is up to date with the latest agentic protocols.
description: Agentic Passport helps humans and other agents verify how compatible your project is with the agentic ecosystem when it comes to discoverability and trustworthiness. It grades you on a 1-100 scale based on how well you have integrated your agent with agentic tooling. One of the best features is ENS DNSSEC check to verify the ENS name is linked to the main domain. Unlike decentralized trust scoring linking your agent ENS name / subname to the claimed TLD domain verifies it is the official agent and cannot be easily tampered with.
how_its_made:
This project incorporates all the latest ENS protocol improvements, including ENSIP-26 and others. The app is built using most common web3 stack (viem, next, etc.). It checks ERC-8004 contracts, Google A2A compatibility, ENS and DNS records to construct the final score.
----------------------
auto_summary: This project evaluates agent projects by checking ENS, DNS, and contract-based signals to generate a compatibility and trust score.
